crossRefs.note: Jonadab said to the king, “Behold, the king’s sons are coming! It is as your servant said.”
crossRefs.keyword: as they servant said. Heb. according to the word of thyservant

people.name: Jonadab
people.line: Nephew of David, friend and advisor to Amnon

translations.web: Jonadab said to the king, “Behold, the king’s sons are coming! It is as your servant said.”
translations.bsb: So Jonadab said to the king, “Look, the sons of the king have arrived! It is just as your servant said.”
translations.kjv: And Jonadab said unto the king, Behold, the king's sons come: as thy servant said, so it is.
translations.asv: And Jonadab said unto the king, Behold, the king's sons are come: as thy servant said, so it is.
